accepted.simpleMeaning: strongly affected by feeling, to the point of being worked up.
accepted.scope: This is not the frantic, out-of-control sense, and not anger; it describes someone strongly moved or worked up by feeling.
examples: She was excited and close to tears after the news.
He gets excited over the smallest piece of good news.
branchCoverage: (of persons) excessively affected by emotion -> strongly affected by feeling, to the point of being worked up
sourceBranches: (of persons) excessively affected by emotion

accepted.definition: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion
accepted.simpleMeaning: filled with wild, unrestrained feeling that cannot be controlled.
accepted.scope: This is not the milder sense of being worked up by feeling, and not anger or mental illness; it means frantic and unable to restrain the feeling.
examples: The children were wildly excited at the sight of the fireworks.
The excited crowd pushed forward against the gates.
branchCoverage: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion -> filled with wild, unrestrained feeling that cannot be controlled
sourceBranches: marked by uncontrolled excitement or emotion

accepted.definition: any physical damage to the body caused by violence or accident or fracture etc.; the condition of an injury
accepted.simpleMeaning: physical harm done to the body by an accident, attack or broken bone, or the condition of being so harmed.
accepted.scope: This is not a wrong or injustice done to someone, and not a person who has been hurt; it is physical damage to the body or the condition that results.
examples: She suffered a serious injury to her knee during the match.
The injury left him unable to walk for months.

accepted.definition: a golf club that has a relatively narrow metal head
accepted.simpleMeaning: a golf club with a fairly narrow metal head.
accepted.scope: This is not the metal, not a tool for pressing clothes, and not a verb meaning to smooth fabric; it names a golf club.
examples: She chose a five iron for the shot to the green.
He switched from a wood to an iron on the narrow fairway.
branchCoverage: a golf club that has a relatively narrow metal head -> a golf club with a fairly narrow metal head
sourceBranches: a golf club that has a relatively narrow metal head

accepted.definition: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way
accepted.simpleMeaning: often sweet and charming in a childlike or innocent way, and easy to feel fond of.
accepted.scope: This is not about physical beauty; it describes a person or manner that is sweet and endearing in a childlike way.
examples: The children's lovely manners impressed all the guests.
His lovely, trusting manner made people want to protect him.
branchCoverage: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way -> often sweet and charming in a childlike or innocent way, and easy to feel fond of
sourceBranches: lovable especially in a childlike or naive way

accepted.simpleMeaning: wildly excited and unable to control your feelings.
